name: skills
help:
usage: work skills [-h]
                      {catalog,snapshot,selection-validate,selection-build} ...

positional arguments:
  {catalog,snapshot,selection-validate,selection-build}

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.

children.name: catalog
children.help:
usage: work skills catalog --root ROOT [--disabled-source DISABLED_SOURCE]

Retired: Host discovery is required; Work validates explicit formal skill selections.

children.name: snapshot
children.help:
usage: work skills snapshot [-h] --root ROOT --source SOURCE

options:
  -h, --help       Return command help in a JSON response.
  --root ROOT
  --source SOURCE

children.name: selection-validate
children.help:
usage: work skills selection-validate [-h] --root ROOT
                                         --input-file INPUT_FILE

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.
  --root ROOT
  --input-file INPUT_FILE

children.name: selection-build
children.help:
usage: work skills selection-build [-h] [--root ROOT]
                                      --input-file INPUT_FILE

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.
  --root ROOT
  --input-file INPUT_FILE
